question_text: Respondent Classification (Fine Jewelry Buyer / General Population)
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'TARGET FOR GEN POP (SHORT COMPLETE): WOMEN LIVING IN THE US, AGE 18-77, HHI OF $150,000 OR MORE' and 'TARGET FOR FINE JEWELRY BUYERS (LONG COMPLETE): IN ADDITION TO ALL SHORT COMPLETE CRITERIA, MUST ALSO: Have purchased or shared in purchase decision for a single item of fine jewelry at $500 or more in the past 2 years AND Own at least 1 fine jewelry item valued at $1,500 or more' | CONTEXT: Respondents are classified into two main groups based on a combination of demographic criteria (gender, age, HHI) and fine jewelry purchasing/ownership behavior (B01, B03, B05, B12). This classification dictates the survey path (Long Complete for Fine Jewelry Buyers, Short Complete for General Population) and is explicitly defined for quota management.
grouping_hint: Primary classification of respondents based on demographic and fine jewelry purchasing/ownership behavior, explicitly defined for survey routing and quota fulfillment.

question_text: Age Groups for Quota Tracking
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'SET UP HIDDEN VARIABLE FOR BELOW AGE BREAKS TO TRACK CENSUS REP COMPLETES (INCLUDE IN DECIPHER QUOTAS) - 18 to 34: 11%, 35 to 44: 25%, 45 to 54: 26%, 55 to 64: 24%, 65 to 77: 14%' | CONTEXT: Numerical age input from A03 is grouped into predefined age bands (18-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65-77) for census balancing and quota tracking.
grouping_hint: Numerical age data is converted into categorical age ranges for demographic segmentation and quota fulfillment.

question_text: Qualified Household Income
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'TARGET FOR GEN POP (SHORT COMPLETE): HHI OF $150,000 OR MORE' and 'TERMINATE r1-r4' (for A05 options Less than $150,000) | CONTEXT: Respondents are qualified based on a minimum household income of $150,000. Those reporting less than $150,000 in A05 are terminated, effectively creating a binary classification for qualified respondents.
grouping_hint: Binary classification based on a minimum household income threshold for survey qualification.

question_text: Geographic Region
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'CREATE VARIABLE FOR REGION (INCLUDE IN DECIPHER QUOTAS) - NORTHEAST: 20%, MIDWEST: 20%, SOUTH: 34%, WEST: 26%' and detailed state mappings on page 5 | CONTEXT: State selection from A11 is grouped into four major US geographic regions (Northeast, Midwest, South, West) for census balancing and quota tracking, with explicit state-to-region mappings provided.
grouping_hint: Geographic data (state) is aggregated into broader regional categories for demographic segmentation and quota fulfillment.

question_text: Ethnicity/Race Groups for Quota Tracking
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'SET UP ETHNICITY QUOTA FOR CENSUS BALANCE TRACKING (INCLUDE IN DECIPHER QUOTAS) - WHITE: 77%, BLACK: 8%, ASIAN: 6%, HISPANIC: 9%, OTHER NET: MAX 6%' | CONTEXT: Multiple ethnicity/race selections from A15 are grouped into broader categories (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic), with several smaller groups combined into an 'OTHER NET' category, for census balancing and quota tracking.
grouping_hint: Detailed ethnicity/race data is grouped into broader categories, including an 'Other Net' for smaller groups, for demographic segmentation and quota fulfillment.

question_text: Fine Jewelry Buyer Spend Type
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'SET UP HIDDEN VARIABLE (HFJTYPE) TO CLASSIFY FINE JEWELRY BUYERS BY JEWELRY SPEND TYPE ON B03 (INCLUDE IN DECIPHER QUOTAS AS SOFT QUOTA TO MONITOR FOR LONG COMPLETES ONLY, NO MINIMUMS) - Access: $500-$1,500, Premium: $1,501-$3,000, Luxe: $3,001-$5,999, Luxe Plus: $6,000+' | CONTEXT: For 'Fine Jewelry Buyers', their reported spend on a single item of fine jewelry (B03) is categorized into four distinct spend tiers: Access, Premium, Luxe, and Luxe Plus. This is used for monitoring within the Long Complete segment.
grouping_hint: Numerical spending data is converted into banded categories to segment fine jewelry buyers by their spending habits.

question_text: Fine Jewelry Purchase Channel Groups
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'RANDOMIZE BUT KEEP ROWS AS A GROUP WHERE NOTED - GROUP 1-2: Mono-brand Jewelry brand store/boutique, Mono-brand Jewelry brand website; GROUP 3-4: Department store, Department store website; GROUP 5-6: Multi-brand Jewelry store, Multi-brand Jewelry website; GROUP 7-8: Consignment/Resale Physical Store, Consignment/Resale Online' | CONTEXT: Individual fine jewelry purchase channels from C20 are explicitly grouped into broader categories (Mono-brand, Department Store, Multi-brand, Consignment/Resale) for analytical purposes.
grouping_hint: Multiple specific purchase channels are combined into broader, more general categories for analysis.

question_text: Fine Jewelry Brand Category Awareness/Ownership
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'CREATE NETS WITH BRAND CATEGORY HERITAGE/FASHION/CONTEMPORARY' (D21 and F04) | CONTEXT: For each respondent, a variable is created to indicate which categories of fine jewelry brands (Heritage, Fashion, Contemporary) they are aware of (D21) or have owned (D23, F04, F05). The individual brands are pre-classified into these categories.
grouping_hint: Pre-defined classification of individual brands into broader strategic categories, used to create a 'net' variable indicating a respondent's engagement with these categories.

question_text: Pearl Interest Classification
recode_hint: QUESTIONNAIRE TEXT: 'IF D29 = (1) OR (2), CLASSIFY AS 'PEARL NON-CONSIDERERS'; IF D29 = (3) OR (4) OR (5), CLASSIFY AS 'PEARL CONSIDERERS'' (D29 and F07) | CONTEXT: Respondents' interest level in pearls/jewelry with pearls (D29/F07) is grouped into a binary classification: 'Pearl Considerers' (those selecting 3, 4, or 5 on the interest scale) and 'Pearl Non-Considerers' (those selecting 1 or 2).
grouping_hint: Ordinal scale of interest is grouped into a binary classification for segmentation based on pearl consideration.
